venue.name: Heiahallen
venue.details: Idrettshallen - Go anticlockwise around the building to find the entrance

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2025, denne gangen hold i Lierskogen. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).

---

## 🇬🇧 Information
Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2025, held in Lierskogen. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.name: Slovak Championship 2025
items.information:
Táto súťaž je uznaná ako Majstrovstvá Slovenska pre rok 2025 a je organizovaná našou regionálnou organizáciou [Speedcubing Slovakia](https://speedcubingslovakia.sk)!

This competition is recognized as a National Championship for the year 2025 and is organized by our regional organization [Speedcubing Slovakia](https://speedcubingslovakia.sk)!

items.name: CubingUSA New England Championship 2025
items.information:
We are pleased to announce the 2025 CubingUSA New England Championship!

This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine are eligible to win the title of New England Champion.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjI1MTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--91e6ff49dd858ef5ca2d73c0cfcd6269eb7deb89/NEC2025-Logo.png)

items.name: CubingUSA Great Lakes Championship 2025
items.information:
![GLC 2025 Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTA4ODgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--06655aacf63e94a0dc9e3368eb27d87f34b64986/Asset%2027@4x.png)
![Partnered organizations logos](https://i.imgur.com/ghYzBXw.png)

This competition is supported by the *[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)* and *[CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/)* as the Great Lakes Regional Championship of 2025.

Competitors from Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, and Wisconsin are eligible for the title of Great Lakes Champion.
